name: UCloud Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: UCloud Technology Co., Ltd. provides basic cloud computing services in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Europe, the America, Southeast Asia, and Africa. It develops IaaS, PaaS, big data circulation platforms, and AI service platforms. The company also offers cloud products, including public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, and dedicated cloud; digital transformation and upgrading services to users in industries, such as government, AI big data models, industrial internet, telecommunications, education, healthcare, retail, finance, and the internet. UCloud Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
